hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Every element in the strictly increasing array must retain all set bits of x so that their cumulative bitwise and remains equal to x.

hints.title: Available Bit Positions
hints.text: The positions where x has zero bits are free to take any value without violating the bitwise and requirement.

hints.title: Bit Insertion
hints.text: To minimize the n-th element, insert the binary bits of n - 1 sequentially into the zero-bit positions of x.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise scanning over at most 62 bits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through integers testing bitwise and takes O(n) operations which times out for n up to 10^8.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map the bits of n - 1 directly onto the unset bits of x.
